lens: iPhone 17 Pro back triple camera 6.765mm f/1.78
source_photo: IMG_8878.jpg (one of the 28 in data/my_capture/manifest.csv, all with the same values below)
focal_length_note: Estimate, not a calibration. The 35 mm equivalent is matched here on the frame diagonal (the usual convention; EXIF does not say how the phone computed it): f_px = f35 * diagonal_px / 43.2666 (the diagonal of a 36 x 24 mm frame). EXIF gives the sensor frame as 8064 x 6048 (portrait 6048 x 8064, diagonal 10080 px); the saved photo is 4536 x 8064, the same 8064 px height, so it is a crop at the same pixel scale and f_px is unchanged.
principal_point_note: Assumed at the centre of the saved photo (4536/2, 8064/2). Not measured: if the 9:16 crop was not centred, cx shifts.
pixel_note: My chosen pixel, left of and below the centre. In IMG_8878 it falls on the floor just left of the statue's base.
pixel_convention: continuous (u, v) used as is, the same as ray_generator.pixel_to_camera_dir; u = column from the left, v = row from the top (grows downward)
